opening.argument: The video presents a purported free $10 Victoria's Secret gift card as something viewers can obtain, using the brand's imagery and a direct instruction to pursue the offer through the description link. Its title expressly promises “Free Victoria's Secrets $10 Gift Card,” while the displayed card and instructions direct viewers to follow that external route. The description supplies a URL referring to a free Victoria's Secret gift card. These are the hallmarks of a low-barrier reward diversion, although the available evidence does not establish what happens at the destination or whether any card is issued.
